subject: Regional silo provisioning & term rebalancing — StarLake renewal
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@starlakehealth.com>

Cc: procurement@starlakehealth.com
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal: add regional analytics silo + term question

Lauren —

Thanks for the continued partnership. Our renewal for the Private/VPC environment is coming up at the end of May. Two asks from our side as we review options: 1) we need to provision an isolated analytics silo (separate VPC and cluster) for our data science workloads — estimate +3 dedicated clusters initially, with potential to add 2 more next quarter; and 2) were evaluating term length: we prefer a 12-month renewal but are open to 24 months if theres material pricing or credit concessions.

Can you share a proposal that shows: per-cluster monthly delta, one-time migration/proration logistics, and any renewal credits you can offer for committing to 24 months? Ive attached the current contract and our procurement contact is looped. We are timeboxed: quarter close next week.

Attachments: StarLake_current_contract.pdf

—
Sanjay Rao
Head of Cloud Engineering
StarLake Health

From: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@starlakehealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, monica_patel@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: add regional analytics silo + term question

Sanjay —

Appreciate the note and the urgency. High level response below, we can follow with a short call this week to lock numbers and sign:

- Capacity: +3 isolated analytics clusters in your US-East private VPC as requested. Per-cluster delta: $12,500/mo for the first 3 clusters (production-optimized instance profile). If you add +2 next quarter we can honor the same rate for 90 days from this quote.
- Term options: 12-month base vs 24-month commit. For 24 months we can provide a 9% recurring credit on the additional clusters and a one-time migration credit equal to one month of the incremental run-rate (applied as upfront invoice credit). For 12 months we can offer a one-time 5% onboarding credit.
- Proration and cutover: well pro-rate capacity start date and provide a 30-day canary seeding window to verify KV cache warmup and routing policies.
- Isolation: the analytics silo will have dedicated subnet, VPC peering policy, and separate audit log stream (well provide SOC2 evidence and KMS integration details).

Im attaching a preliminary SOW (SOW-satellite-cluster.xlsx) with schedule and lead times. Karthik and Kimberly will follow with ops and security details. Monica will propose a mutual action plan and timeline for signatures.

If this broadly aligns, Ill turn this into redlines and route through DocuSign so procurement can sign by quarter close.

Best,

Lauren Bishop
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0189

Attachments: SOW-satellite-cluster.xlsx

From: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com

Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: add regional analytics silo + term question

Sanjay / Lauren —

Quick technical notes on provisioning and cutover: 
- Lead time: For private VPC additions we typically schedule cluster provisioning 7-10 business days after PO/signature for cloud-hosted private environments. If you choose on-prem appliance nodes, add 4-6 weeks for hardware procurement and air-gap prep.
- Canary plan: suggest seeding 1 cluster first for analytics to validate routing/bandwidth and KV cache behavior, then expand the remaining 2 clusters after 14 days. This reduces cache miss-rate and keeps latency SLOs stable.
- Migration credit: we can structure the migration credit as a three-way proration: 1) apply a one-time invoice credit equal to 10% of the incremental monthly run-rate (first invoice), 2) prorate the first partial month for clusters that go live mid-cycle, and 3) absorb up to 80 hours of professional services for routing and partitioning work as part of the credit.
- Security: Kimberly will attach the short checklist for KMS/HSM key exchange and log streaming to your SIEM. We can provide a scoped SOC2 readout and encrypted-in-transit/in-rest certs.

Ive updated the SOW to show the staged schedule and proration math — see SOW-satellite-cluster.xlsx (tab: pricing & timeline).

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Customer Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com

Lauren / Karthik —

Thanks for the details. A few follow-ups from procurement and security: 
- Procurement wants the final redlines submitted and an explicit DocuSign envelope for signatures by EOD Friday (were closing the quarter).
- Security asks for an audit artifact: sample log stream and encryption proof (TLS1.3 + KMS wrapping). Can you point to the SOC2 report section that covers log export retention and access controls?
- SLA: given the criticality of analytics workflows, wed like to add a 99.9% availability SLA for the analytics silo or a service credit schedule if monthly availability drops below that threshold.

If you can provide the redlined contract and DocuSign link plus the SOC2 excerpt, well prioritize signature.

—
Sanjay
